summary.it: Confermata la registry didattica verificata su IANA, incluse le ambiguità de facto e le alternative cifrate.
summary.en: Confirmed the teaching registry checked against IANA, including de-facto ambiguities and encrypted alternatives.

summary.it: Ricontrollati comandi Cisco IOS/IOS XE e Linux esposti nei laboratori; restano esempi contestuali con verifica e rollback.
summary.en: Rechecked Cisco IOS/IOS XE and Linux commands exposed by the labs; they remain contextual examples with verification and rollback.

summary.it: TLS 1.0/1.1 e SNMPv1/v2c erano già indicati come legacy; aggiunto il divieto esplicito di SSHv1 e mantenute le alternative TLS moderne, SSHv2 e SNMPv3 authPriv.
summary.en: TLS 1.0/1.1 and SNMPv1/v2c were already marked legacy; added an explicit SSHv1 prohibition and retained modern TLS, SSHv2, and SNMPv3 authPriv alternatives.

summary.it: Confermati TLS 1.2/1.3, chiavi RSA da almeno 2048 bit negli esempi e l’uso didattico di SHA-1/3DES/WEP solo come tecnologie legacy o deboli.
summary.en: Confirmed TLS 1.2/1.3, RSA keys of at least 2048 bits in examples, and SHA-1/3DES/WEP only as legacy or weak teaching material.

summary.it: Confermati versione 200-301 v1.1, sei domini, pesi e 53 obiettivi numerati collegati alle viste reali.
summary.en: Confirmed version 200-301 v1.1, six domains, weights, and 53 numbered objectives linked to real views.

summary.it: Confermata ATT&CK v19.2 come versione corrente, corretta la data di rilascio al 28 aprile 2026 e ricontrollati gli identificativi delle tecniche referenziate.
summary.en: Confirmed ATT&CK v19.2 as the current version, corrected its release date to 28 April 2026, and rechecked the referenced technique identifiers.
